modern: What are these men’s leading principles, and what kind of things are they busy about, and for what kind of reasons do they love and honour? Imagine that you see their poor souls laid bare. When they think that they do harm by their blame or good by their praise, what an idea!
original: What are these men’s leading principles, and about what kind of things are they busy, and for what kind of reasons do they love and honor? Imagine that thou seest their pool souls laid bare. When they think that they do harm by their blame or good by their praise, what an idea!

explained.summary: Ask what really guides the people whose opinions you worry about, what they spend their time on, and why they love and admire what they do. Imagine their souls laid bare. The idea that their blame could hurt you or their praise could help you starts to look absurd.
explained.today: Think of the people whose likes, comments or performance reviews you anxiously track. Picture what actually drives them day to day, and their thumbs-up or frown becomes less of a verdict on your worth.
